purpose: Human field-quality evidence for the integrated Gate 4 candidate. This gate does not claim production readiness.

first_view: overall trip identity and three-region journey
all four route strategies with understandable trade-offs
conditional, swap, bonus, recovery, and choice meanings
freshness/recheck status near the affected planning surface
hard_gates: no critical action or explanation is hover-only
keyboard focus is visible, ordered, owned, and returned after overlays/panels
critical controls have accessible names and selected/expanded/pressed semantics
no keyboard trap, accidental horizontal overflow, critical clipping, or center-control occlusion
Korean/English and light/dark critical states remain coherent
Smart local-first and Gate 4 recovery invariants remain green
performance evidence is exact-candidate-bound and variance-aware
wcag_oriented_checks: mechanically checkable contrast and non-color state cues
focus visibility, collision/occlusion, and DOM accessibility semantics

environment_signature: headless/display backend and software GL mode
sample count and interaction repeat count
performance.comparability_rule: A hard timing comparison is permitted only when both samples carry equal environment signatures, exact clean source bindings, and at least two independently order-balanced blocks with six or more total fresh pairs per side. An absent or materially different signature/binding, missing block identity, unbalanced order, insufficient pairs, inconsistent block direction, or unstable block materiality is VERIFY_REQUIRED; it can never become PASS from an unpaired distribution guard.
performance.baseline_preference: Candidate qualification builds comparison base 75d1f127dd5ce332df54e205e9a3d152de7af176 in a temporary detached worktree and interleaves it with the candidate on the same runner/viewport/display/software-GL conditions. It records two independent order-balanced blocks of four pairs, reverses the first side between blocks, uses a fresh browser context/page for every side, and isolates deterministic base/candidate builds. If that cannot be obtained, evidence remains VERIFY_REQUIRED.
performance.noise_rule: Paired deltas are primary. The evidence-derived noise envelope is the larger of robust paired-delta spread (MAD scaled to sigma) and between-block median spread, with relative equivalents also recorded. A decisive FAIL requires every pair to be candidate-slower, every balanced block to be candidate-slower, and the effect to exceed that observed envelope. Stable paired non-regression may PASS; directionally or materially unstable evidence is VERIFY_REQUIRED.
performance.guard_rationale: The legacy unpaired max(baseline max, baseline mean + 3*baseline stdev) guard is retained as an audit distribution guard only. It cannot convert a directionally consistent paired regression into PASS when baseline variance is inflated by an outlier. Raw distributions, raw paired values, deltas, relative deltas, baseline jitter, block/order identities, derived noise/materiality guards, and rationale are all recorded.
performance.source_binding: Reports record the exact clean checked-out revision when available, otherwise a deterministic source fingerprint and dirty-source reason. A claimed exact revision mismatch is fail-closed/VERIFY_REQUIRED and cannot silently pass.

evidence.same_environment_baseline: generated temporary detached worktree at the authoritative comparison base, uploaded from the exact hosted run

acceptance_boundaries.implementation_status: PASS means objective Gate 5 checks passed for the exact candidate; it is not a production-readiness claim.
acceptance_boundaries.independent_review: VERIFY_REQUIRED unless independently supplied, candidate-bound multimodal visual/usability review exists.
acceptance_boundaries.real_device: VERIFY_REQUIRED when the execution environment cannot establish a real field-device metric.
acceptance_boundaries.rights: Photo and third-party redistribution rights are outside this gate.
